name: SEOAuto AI Content Publisher
author: bedeleu

sections.description:
SEOAuto AI Content Publisher connects your WordPress site with SEOAuto – an AI-powered SEO content platform. This plugin enables automatic publishing of high-quality, SEO-optimized articles directly to your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Automatic Publishing – Articles generated in SEOAuto are automatically published to your WordPress site
  • Zero Configuration – Just enter your API key and start receiving content
  • SEO Plugin Integration – Native support for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress
  • Media Handling – Automatic download and attachment of featured images
  • Content Enhancements – Support for YouTube video embeds and infographics
  • Scheduled Sync – Configurable automatic synchronization intervals
  • Dashboard – Overview of synced articles and connection status

Supported SEO Plugins

SEOAuto automatically detects and integrates with the following SEO plugins:

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math
  • All in One SEO
  • SEOPress

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active SEOAuto subscription

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to SEOAuto > Settings
  3. Enter your API key from your SEOAuto dashboard
  4. Configure your publishing preferences
  5. Articles will automatically sync and publish based on your settings

External Services

This plugin relies on the SEOAuto API service to function. SEOAuto is an AI-powered SEO content platform that generates and manages articles for your website.

The plugin connects to: https://api.seoauto.io

What the service does

The SEOAuto API is required to:
* Validate your API key and authenticate your WordPress site
* Receive AI-generated article content for publishing
* Synchronize article status between SEOAuto and WordPress
* Confirm successful publication of articles

Data transmitted

The following data is sent to the SEOAuto API:
* Your WordPress site URL (to identify your site)
* WordPress version (for compatibility checks)
* PHP version (for compatibility checks)
* Plugin version (for compatibility checks)
* API key (for authentication)
* Article publication status and WordPress post IDs (to sync content)

Data is transmitted:
* When you connect the plugin using your API key
* During automatic or manual article synchronization
* When articles are published, updated, or deleted

Service links

  • Service provider: SEOAuto (https://seoauto.io)
  • Terms of Service: https://seoauto.io/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://seoauto.io/privacy

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to the SEOAuto API (api.seoauto.io) to:

  • Validate your API key
  • Receive article content for publishing
  • Send publication confirmations

Data transmitted includes:
* Your WordPress site URL
* WordPress and PHP versions
* Article publication status

For more information, see the SEOAuto Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “SEOAuto AI Content Publisher”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Navigate to SEOAuto > Settings to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Navigate to SEOAuto > Settings to configure
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API key?

Your API key is available in your SEOAuto dashboard under Settings > WordPress Integration. If you don’t have a SEOAuto account, visit seoauto.io to sign up.

What happens to my articles if I deactivate the plugin?

Your published articles remain on your WordPress site. Deactivating the plugin only stops the sync with SEOAuto.

Can I edit articles after they’re published?

Articles are protected by default to prevent accidental changes. You can edit them in your SEOAuto dashboard, and changes will sync to WordPress.

How often does the plugin sync?

By default, the plugin syncs every hour. You can change this in Settings > Advanced to hourly, twice daily, or daily.

Does this work with multisite?

Currently, the plugin is designed for single-site WordPress installations. Multisite support is planned for a future release.

What if the featured image fails to download?

The article will still be published, but without a featured image. Check the SEOAuto dashboard for the original image URL and manually add it if needed.
